title: Rabbit’s new AI agent doesn’t need an R1 to run
summary: Rabbit, the company behind the underwhelming R1 device, is rolling out a standalone AI agent that you don't need its hardware to use, as reported earlier by Wired. The startup says its new OS3 "agentic operating system" runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac,
reason: Rabbit's OS3 standalone AI agent is a non-model product launch covered by The Verge, a reputable media outlet, with no official owner announcement, so it falls under industry business/product news rather than model releases.
